purpose: Document first-party Hamilton, Ontario parcel-source discovery and bounded anonymous geometry review.
assessment: A City of Hamilton-attributed public ArcGIS Hamilton Assessment Parcel layer was verified. Anonymous layer metadata exposed polygon geometry, CRS, and OBJECTID; a bounded WGS84 envelope returned three full polygons with only OBJECTID requested.
registryAssessment: Local municipal open-data and mapping custody is evidenced. The layer metadata says the item access information is City of Hamilton and the item snippet identifies Teranet data received February 9, 2024; this is source evidence, not runtime admission.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official City page says the Open Data catalogue contains public information and links to open.hamilton.ca.
Official City open-data portal landing page.
Public item metadata names Hamilton Assessment Parcel, attributes access information to City of Hamilton, gives the service URL, extent, and Teranet date note.
Public layer metadata identifies polygon geometry, OBJECTID as system-maintained unique ID, and native spatial reference 102100/3857.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: No point coordinate was moved. The bounded envelope around the exact WUP point returned parcel features; this is not a citywide completeness test.

requestEvidence.outcome: Three polygon features returned; GeoJSON CRS EPSG:4326; response flagged exceededTransferLimit=true.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official City of Hamilton open-data pages, public ArcGIS item metadata, layer schema, and one bounded parcel query.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public anonymous parcel geometry and native IDs in the tested envelope only.

remainingUncertainty: No citywide count, pagination, completeness, legal cadastral status, or runtime adapter qualification was performed. Raw source-specific attributes were not retained.
